dagger_note: † = not in the SA STG (source named). Doses and mixes from STG pages shown; recheck units (mg vs mcg) before drawing up

top_question.t: MIX: adrenaline 10 mg (10 × 1 mg/mL ampoules) in 1 L sodium chloride 0.9% = 10 mcg/mL

formulas.name: Push-dose mix
formulas.expr: 1 mL adrenaline 1:10 000 (100 mcg) + 9 mL NaCl 0.9% = 10 mcg/mL

interpretation_stg.t: Anaphylaxis — persistent hypotension or repeated IM doses: start 0.05 mcg/kg/min, titrate
Shock — hypotension after volume correction: start 0.1 mcg/kg/min, titrate to response
Infuse according to weight and clinical response; table 0.1–1 mcg/kg/min
Needs infusion → REFER (ICU / high care) once started
Push-dose = bridge only while infusion is made up; label the syringe 10 mcg/mL

notes.t: Large, free-flowing cannula; watch the site (extravasation)
Fill the tank first — volume before pressor (except anaphylaxis)
Push-dose errors: 1 mg/mL drawn up by mistake = 100× dose
BP + HR every 5 min while titrating
Arrest dose is different: 1 mg IV every 3–5 min
